title: Duplicate Sherds
description: This is a Datapack that makes Duplicating Pottery Sherds Possible
body:
This is a Datapack that makes Duplicating Pottery Sherds Possible, To duplicate them you need 4 bricks and 1 of the sherds you want to duplicate
Once you have the Items put them in a crafting table in this shape: A = AIR - B = BRICK - S = SHERD

ABA
BSB
ABA﻿

You will then get a Out put of 2 sherds

If you have any problems/suggestions let me know!
